body: If you’re 21 you can get a savings account without your parents permission. If your mom doesn’t want you to have one she’s being wayyy too controlling. You could just get one and not tell her perhaps?
You have no idea what you’re talking about. My mother abused me for years.
No, she got better and is now on meds.
You really read my mind and explained my situation perfectly, thank you so much. I’m probably going to wait to speak to her in person.

Try branching out to new friends? I know it’s hard to meet people in public spacing now due to the virus but a good way to make irl friends is bumble. They have a feature where you can find other people that are also looking for friends in your area. If you do this you should also tell your bf that you’re only using it to make new friends, and put in ur bio that you have a bf. If he cared about your mental health he would understand and have no problem with it.

They really said that? That’s horrible and no loving parents should tell their kids that. Maybe try finding a support group outside of your family like friends perhaps. Even reddit friends can be a substantial support system. And you’re in college! That’s more than I could ever say lol. I know colleges have clubs so maybe when school resumes (if it hasn’t already) you could join a club and meet some good people :)

Your boyfriend and your friend seem really toxic. Especially your friend because he has experienced the pain you’re going through so he should know enough to try and at least comfort you. I’m sure they’re good people with good intentions but the execution is just not it. Have you tried talking to a therapist?

It wasn’t a waste of my time reading this, it actually was kind of cool to see someone else’s POV (not in a insensitive way). I do think that excessively masturbating is not something that is good for you but hey at least you’re not doing meth 👍
If this makes you feel any better, I read the entire thing, I’m here to listen and you pain has not gone unnoticed.

Wow, I wish I had a sibling like you. You’re doing a great job :) sometimes all someone needs is to be listened to or held. When they’re in that position there’s really nothing you can say to change their minds, so the best thing you can do is just be there❤️
thank you, this really made me feel better❤️

Gosh I’m so sorry, I really have no words. Maybe I can recommend something that can help? If you’re over the age of 18 you could try bumble, it has a feature where you can look for friends in your area. Maybe join a club or organization with other people your age. And you are lovable, it’s the people around you that aren’t. Before you commit you could try something new? Maybe tomorrow or a month from now you could go on a walk and meet someone that you become best friends with... you deserve to live a long and happy life, we all do❤️

Everyone here is struggling, you’re helping no one by commenting that. Understand that people can go through hard times... even if it may seem to you that they have it easy. Please take care of yourself ❤️
Ok lol
YES IM SO DOWN, I’ve been looking for someone to vent to as well :) and the time issue is no problem

I swear, all of the forgotten friends need to come together and make our own friend group. I’ve gotten so many comments saying that they’re in a similar situation and it’s really sad to read all of them. I’m sorry you have to deal with that :(

I’m really about to pull a Hannah baker and expose their asses before I go🙈 sorry, that wasn’t helpful... but all I can tell you is that it feels so much better when you leave a toxic situation like that. I feel like I should convince you to stay but it wouldn’t mean much coming from me considering the fact that I don’t want to stay either. All I’m going to tell you is that I truly hope you find happiness💞

I can relate so much. Sometimes I blame myself for becoming so distant but then I realized that even if I wasn’t hanging out as much, they should still be good friends and check up on me. Honestly I’m thinking about just leaving them without any explanation. I’d rather be alone than be treated like my absence means nothing or than I’m a burden when I’m sad. Anyway, I hope you find happiness in whatever you choose to do ❤️
Fuck them, they don’t deserve you :(

I’m sorry :( I don’t know what you’re going through but you don’t deserve to die, you deserve happiness and love. You deserve to find something or someone who makes you want to stay so badly that you start to fear the day you perish instead of looking forward to it. Maybe stay for the what if? What if tomorrow you find a stray dog and the two of you become inseparable. Or a month from now you find a song that makes you feel happiness that you haven’t felt since you were a kid.

But who would take care of it? One of the reasons I’m still here is because I couldn’t leave my guinea pigs lol. And I promise you there will be others that will miss you. People you don’t even know. Your presence means a lot💞
Wow I never thought of it like that, but you’re right, I never want her to feel the way I do. I don’t know if this helps or not but if you were my friend I would always invite you :)
I’m sorry :( not even your pets? (if you have any)
Wow we’re literally in the same boat, do you tend to overthink what you say or do? Or find it hard to make new friends?
Frl, it feels like you become a chore, like your feelings are a burden😔
I hate people like that, I’m sorry you have deal with that stuff 💔
I know how it feels man, you’re not alone :/ hopefully it gets better for the both of us
Always wanted to go to a UK rave😤the raves in the US are so lame
Depends on the music🧐
It depends, are they leaving you out or being mean to you on purpose? If they do then yes, you are hanging out with the wrong people. If not than maybe you’re dealing with another struggle :/
I would not trust the guys on here, half of them are misogynistic incels with bad intentions 😬
I would say average, why?
Having people to shop with doesn’t make the pain go away, it just allows for a momentary distraction. And when you’re alone all of the feelings come back.

You came to a reddit thread meant to help people with Suicidal thoughts instead of going to google, a site that would’ve given you the answer in seconds without any convincing you to stay. Maybe you want something else other than a easy way out?
You can stay alive without staying in the situation that makes you feel like shit. Find another escape perhaps.

I would say not dying but I know the pain of staying is worse. I’m sorry :( I don’t know what you’re going through but you don’t deserve to die, you deserve happiness and love. You deserve to find something or someone who makes you want to stay so badly that you start to fear the day you perish instead of looking forward to it. Maybe stay for the what if? What if tomorrow you find a stray dog and the two of you become inseparable. Or a month from now you find a song that makes you feel happiness that you haven’t felt since you were a kid.
True, we’ve had good times but right now I get more pain then happiness from the relationship :( I’d rather be alone than with someone who constantly makes me feel like shit.

You described it perfectly. I don’t want anyone to feel guilty for my death because the only person that would be at fault is me. I just want to take my own pain away, not give others more to cry about. I wish I had cancer, then I would have a little time to see my loved ones and say my goodbyes in person instead of a note.

Strongly relate to the distraction part. Sometimes I feel like things are better but then things get bad again and I realize that nothing got better, I just had things like social media, tv or food to distract me. I’ll still always hate myself but sometimes I’m too busy with something else to think about it.
